{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Moves ownership and lifetime management of txindex, txospenderindex, coinstatsindex, and block filter indexes into NodeContext",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Transfers secondary index instances from process-global pointers and static maps into NodeContext. As noted in the description, this 'removes the remaining process-global index ownership', improving node encapsulation and test isolation without altering index correctness or performance."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in net_processing are mechanical adaptations to access indexes through an options callback rather than global state",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter P2P network behavior, message processing, or peer management."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "RPC and REST edits merely update call sites to retrieve index pointers from NodeContext",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify RPC behavior, interfaces, or output format."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to fuzz harnesses and test helpers follow directly from index ownership changes",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify the test framework or add test infrastructure capabilities."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Init changes are limited to index setup and shutdown sequencing under NodeContext",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change general utility primitives, logging, arguments, or libraries."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Matches the 'UTXO Db and Indexes' label only via secondary indexes under src/index/",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes secondary index ownership without touching consensus, block storage, or the UTXO database."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches a wallet test file to update index call sites",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not modify wallet logic, APIs, or data structures."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 0,
    "bug_severity": 0,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
